# Model Check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens while something else happens belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a number of seconds), `variable` (min, max, and optional default), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped). A **startTrigger** ties a step to real time or to another step's completion — `programStart` (t=0), `programStartOffset` (t=offset), `afterStep` (when another step ends, optionally with an offset), `afterStepWithBuffer` (end + buffer), `manual` (user taps), `onAbort` (if another step is aborted), or `compound` (wait for all or the first of several triggers). `stepId`s must be unique across the WHOLE program, never duplicated within a track. Every `task` a step uses must have a matching `resourceConstraints` entry; that entry's `maxConcurrent` value is what prevents two steps from occupying the same oven, microphone, bar or server at the same instant. Work repeated n times — three trays, three samples, three dances — is declared once with `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial"|"parallel"|"stagger"}` on a single step, never as n copied steps. Chain downstream work per repetition with `instances: "each"`, mark the barrier that waits for all instances with `instances: "all"`, and when the holding area (cooling rack, rotor, dance floor) only fits k items at once, set `maxInFlight: k` so the upstream step is held back rather than producing work that cannot be held downstream.

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global; replicates on one step, not copied steps; instances chain per-instance or all-instance work; maxInFlight holds upstream when holding area is full",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "kitchen_pass", "maxConcurrent": 1, "note": "plating bottleneck; one course at a time" },
    { "task": "bar", "maxConcurrent": 1, "note": "foyer bar setup and service" },
    { "task": "microphone", "maxConcurrent": 1, "note": "MC-controlled: welcome, speeches, cake cut announcement" },
    { "task": "server", "maxConcurrent": 2, "note": "two servers on floor: serve starters, clear starters, serve mains, clear mains, serve dessert" },
    { "task": "room_setup", "maxConcurrent": 1, "note": "planner: flip chairs, dress tables, seat guests" },
    { "task": "dance_floor", "maxConcurrent": 1, "note": "first dance and dancing; one at a time (shared resource)" }
  ],
  "actors": 4,
  "note": "actors: one planner (room call), one MC (microphone), two servers on floor; kitchen staff implicitly handle the pass"
}
```
